text:
kai: Flux is failing to prune HelmReleases in the gpu-pool namespace; reconcile keeps looping with prune conflicts. anyone oncall?

flux-bot: ERROR reconcile failed for HelmRelease gpu-job-allocator: unable to prune resource batch/v1 Job/gpu-allocator-job: conflict deleting resource: finalizers present

maria: seeing the same in staging. helmrelease stuck in Terminating because post-delete hook pod never scheduled (nodeAffinity for nvidia-gpu).

sam: can you paste the exact flux log line and the helmrelease finalizers snippet?

kai: logs + output below:

```
time="2026-03-18T09:12:03Z" level=error msg="prune failed" controller=helmrelease resource=gpu-job-allocator/gpu-cr: conflict deleting resource batch/v1 Job/gpu-allocator-job: 'finalizers [finalizer.helm.fluxcd.io]' present
```

```
kubectl get helmrelease -n gpu-pool gpu-job-allocator -o yaml | yq '.metadata.finalizers'
- "finalizer.helm.fluxcd.io"
```

olivia: root cause looks like helm controller couldn't finish uninstall hooks because the job couldn't schedule on tainted GPU nodes. finalizer blocks deletion -> flux can't prune -> reconcile keeps re-adding resources.

sam: quick mitigation is to remove the finalizer so flux can continue pruning, but do that only after confirming the orphaned resources are safe to remove. command: 

```
kubectl patch helmrelease -n gpu-pool gpu-job-allocator -p '{"metadata":{"finalizers":null}}' --type=merge
```

kai: alternative is to reattach ownerReferences on the orphaned resources pointing to the HelmRelease so prune sees them as owned and deletes succeed. which is safer?

maria: if the underlying Job still exists and is stuck pending, reattaching ownerrefs could let helm/flux clean it up. if there's any persistent state, manual delete after investigation is best. also we can pause reconciliation while we fix: `flux suspend hr/gpu-job-allocator -n gpu-pool`.

olivia: i manually removed the finalizer and deleted the orphan Job after confirming it's a stuck post-delete hook. flux resumed and the prune completed. saw about ~60 reconcile attempts while we fixed it.

infra-oncall: note: we should create a short playbook to detect stuck HelmRelease finalizers caused by scheduling failures for post-delete hooks. filing a ticket and assigning owners.

kai: created INFRA-1421 with proposed steps: 1) detect HelmRelease in Terminating with finalizer >5m and any pending pods for post-delete hooks, 2) alert and provide one-click action to remove finalizer after manual verification, 3) longer-term: ensure hooks use tolerations/affinity that allow them to run on control-plane or tainted nodes if appropriate.

sam: i'll take ownerReferences and HelmRelease install-time ownering as follow-up.

olivia: :thumbsup:

kai: thanks all, closing thread.
